mapper.select: SELECT pp.production_plan_id, component.item_id, component.item_code, component.item_name, component.unit, pp.production_qty, b.required_qty AS bom_required_qty, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(inv.current_qty) FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.item_id = b.component_item_id ), 0) AS available_qty, pp.due_date AS required_date FROM production_plan pp JOIN bom b ON b.parent_item_id = pp.item_id JOIN item component ON component.item_id = b.component_item_id WHERE pp.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY pp.due_date, pp.production_plan_id, component.item_code
